title.en: Russian foreign minister says ‘nothing is happening’ in US talks on Ukraine and peace process is stuck – Europe live
title.zh: 俄罗斯外长称美乌会谈“毫无进展”，和平进程陷入僵局

summary.en: Russia's foreign minister, Sergei Lavrov, stated that talks with the United States regarding Ukraine have seen "nothing happening" and that the peace process is stuck. His comments precede a meeting of the 'Bucharest Nine' leaders with NATO's secretary general.
summary.zh: 俄罗斯外交部长谢尔盖·拉夫罗夫表示，与美国就乌克兰问题举行的会谈“毫无进展”，和平进程陷入僵局。他的此番言论发表在“布加勒斯特九国”领导人与北约秘书长会晤之前。

body.en: Sergei Lavrov comments before leaders of the ‘Bucharest Nine’ meet later today with Nato’s secretary general Mark Rutte Elsewhere, it’s probably good to catch up on the results of the last night’s first Eurovision semi-final in Vienna , which saw Israel – at the centre of controversy and some boycotts of this year’s event – qualify for the grand final on Saturday. Israel’s continued participation despite its military operations in Gaza led to a number of countries pulling out , led by Spain and the Netherlands, traditionally Eurovision’s fifth and sixth largest financial contributors, alongside Ireland, the joint record-holder with most winning contributions, Slovenia and Iceland. Continue reading...
body.zh: 谢尔盖·拉夫罗夫在“布加勒斯特九人组”领导人今天晚些时候与北约秘书长马克·吕特会面之前发表了评论。在其他地方，赶上昨晚在维也纳举行的首届欧洲电视网半决赛的结果可能是件好事，以色列——今年赛事的争议中心和一些抵制者——晋级周六的总决赛。尽管以色列在加沙采取军事行动，但以色列继续参与，导致一些国家退出，其中以西班牙和荷兰为首，这两个国家历来是欧洲电视网的第五和第六大财政捐助国，另外还有爱尔兰（获胜捐款最多的纪录保持者）、斯洛文尼亚和冰岛。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news of stalled peace talks highlights the immense difficulty in resolving complex international conflicts. Romans 12:18 reminds us of the personal and collective call to pursue peace, "If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone." While global peace often feels beyond our control, this verse encourages persistent effort...
reflection.zh: 和平谈判陷入僵局的消息，凸显了解决复杂国际冲突的巨大难度。罗马书12:18提醒我们，个人和集体都有追求和平的呼召：“若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。” 尽管全球和平常感力不从心，但这节经文鼓励我们在生活的各个领域，持续努力并致力于和解。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Wes Streeting leaves No 10 after planned talks with Keir Starmer last less than 20 minutes - UK politics live
title.zh: 韦斯·斯特里廷与基尔·斯塔默的会谈不足20分钟后离开唐宁街10号 - 英国政治直播

summary.en: Planned talks between Wes Streeting and Keir Starmer at No 10 concluded in under 20 minutes, amid calls from Streeting's allies for the prime minister's resignation. However, a formal leadership challenge from Streeting did not materialize, offering a reprieve to Starmer.
summary.zh: 韦斯·斯特里廷与基尔·斯塔默在唐宁街10号的会谈在不到20分钟内结束。此前，斯特里廷的盟友曾呼吁首相辞职，但斯特里廷本人尚未正式发起领导权挑战，这为斯塔默争取到了一线生机。

body.en: A number of the health secretary’s allies called for the prime minister’s resignation but Streeting has yet to call for a formal leadership challenge Report: Starmer given a lifeline after Streeting challenge fails to materialise Libby Brooks is the Guardian’s Scotland correspondent. An odd dispute of interpretation has emerged overnight between the Scottish and UK governments. Yesterday evening a Scottish government spokesperson announced that, during a call between first minister John Swinney and prime minister Kier Starmer, both parties agreed to meet face to face next month to discuss a referendum on independence. It is particularly welcome that the prime minister agreed to meet next month to discuss a referendum on independence. The PM committed to meeting to discussed shared issues including the cost of living. As the PM told the first minister, the manifesto this government was elected on was unambiguous that ‘Labour does not support independence or another referendum’. Our position remains unchanged. We, in Scotland, as in the rest of the UK, had a devastating set of election results and we were simply unable to articulate our offering, or indeed critique, of the SNP government because of the noise created at the centre. Therefore, we became, and the prime minister became, the inadvertent midwife of a fifth-term SNP government. And that scenario you saw then, people waiting for a speech to try and articulate his new direction, a strategy, and it simply was not forthcoming. This is not one faction of the Labour party. This is about the Labour party articulating, I think, now a commonly held view that this is unsustainable and unstable. Continue reading...
body.zh: 卫生部长的一些盟友呼吁总理辞职，但斯特里廷尚未呼吁对领导层提出正式挑战。 报道：在斯特里廷的挑战未能实现后，斯塔默获得了一线生机。 《卫报》驻苏格兰记者利比·布鲁克斯 (Libby Brooks) 表示。苏格兰和英国政府之间一夜之间出现了奇怪的解释争议。昨天晚上，苏格兰政府发言人宣布，在首席部长约翰·斯温尼和首相基尔·斯塔默的通话中，双方同意下个月面对面讨论独立公投。特别值得欢迎的是，总理同意下个月会面讨论独立公投。总理承诺召开会议讨论包括生活费用在内的共同问题。正如首相告诉首席部长的那样，本届政府当选的宣言明确表示“工党不支持独立或另一次公投”。我们的立场保持不变。我们在苏格兰，就像在英国其他地方一样，获得了一系列毁灭性的选举结果，而且由于中心产生的噪音，我们根本无法清楚地表达我们对苏格兰民族党政府的提议，甚至是批评。因此，我们和首相无意中成为了第五届苏格兰民族党政府的助产士。你当时看到的场景是，人们在等待演讲，试图阐明他的新方向、一项战略，但它根本没有出现。这不是工党的一个派别。我认为，这是关于工党阐明了现在普遍持有的观点，即这是不可持续和不稳定的。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Political life often involves navigating ambition and disagreement, as seen in the brief talks and unmaterialized challenge. This reminds us of the call to approach leadership and public service with humility, prioritizing the common good over personal gain or position. True strength in leadership often emerges when individuals seek to serve rather than to...
reflection.zh: 政治生活常涉及驾驭抱负与分歧，正如这次短暂的会谈和未能实现的挑战所反映。这提醒我们，在领导和公共服务中，要以谦卑的态度行事，将共同利益置于个人得失或地位之上。领导力的真正力量，往往在于寻求服务而非掌控。

verse.textEn: Do nothing out of selfish ambition or vain conceit. Rather, in humility value others above yourselves.
verse.textZh: 凡事不可结党，不可贪图虚浮的荣耀；只要存心谦卑，各人看别人比自己强。

title.en: Bodies of three women recovered from sea off Brighton
title.zh: 布莱顿附近海域打捞出三名女性尸体

summary.en: Sussex police have reported the recovery of the bodies of three women from the sea off Brighton. Officers are working to identify the women and determine the circumstances of their deaths.
summary.zh: 萨塞克斯警方表示，已从布莱顿附近海域打捞出三名女性的尸体。警方正在努力确认这些女性的身份，并查明她们的死因。

body.en:
The bodies of three women have been recovered from the sea off Brighton, Sussex police said.

The force said emergency services were called to concerns for the welfare of three women in the sea off Brighton at around 5.45am on Wednesday.

Ch Supt Adam Hays said: “This is a tragic incident and fast-moving inquiries are ongoing to confirm the identities of these three women and understand exactly what has happened.

“I know this is concerning for the community, but I would ask the public to stay away from the scene at this time while emergency services continue their work.
body.zh: 苏塞克斯警方表示，三名女性的尸体已从布莱顿附近的海域打捞出来。 警方表示，周三凌晨 5 点 45 分左右，紧急服务人员接到电话，担心布莱顿附近海域三名妇女的安危。 警长亚当·海斯 (Adam Hays) 表示：“这是一起悲惨事件，我们正在进行快速调查，以确认这三名女性的身份并确切了解发生了什么。 “我知道这让社区感到担忧，但我要求公众此时远离现场，而紧急服务部门仍在继续工作。

reflection.en: The tragic discovery of three women's bodies from the sea brings profound sadness and a stark reminder of life's fragility. In moments of such deep loss, we hold onto the promise of a future where all tears will be wiped away, and death and sorrow will be no more. This hope offers solace even when understanding is elusive.
reflection.zh: 从海中打捞出三名女性尸体的悲剧性发现，带来了深深的悲伤，也严酷地提醒我们生命的脆弱。在如此深重的失落时刻，我们紧紧抓住一个未来的应许：那时所有的眼泪都将被擦去，死亡和悲伤将不复存在。这份盼望在难以理解的境况中带来慰藉。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: Starmer holds 16-minute meeting with Streeting amid leadership crisis
title.zh: 斯塔默在领导层危机中与斯特里廷举行16分钟会晤

summary.en: Amidst a leadership crisis, Keir Starmer held a meeting with Wes Streeting in Downing Street. An ally of the health secretary has called for the prime minister to announce a timetable for his departure before the king’s speech.
summary.zh: 在一次领导层危机中，基尔·斯塔默在唐宁街与韦斯·斯特里廷举行了会晤。一位卫生大臣的盟友呼吁首相在国王演讲前公布其离任时间表。

body.en: Ally of health secretary calls for prime minister to set out timetable for departure ahead of king’s speech • UK politics live – latest updates Wes Streeting has held talks with Keir Starmer in Downing Street as an ally of the health secretary renewed calls for the prime minister to resign, saying his authority had “irretrievably ebbed away”. Streeting arrived in No 10 on Wednesday morning amid intense speculation over Labour’s leadership crisis and his own future within the party . He left approximately 16 minutes later without commenting to the media. Continue reading...
body.zh: 卫生部长的盟友呼吁首相在国王演讲之前制定离开时间表 • 英国政治直播 – 最新动态 韦斯·斯特里廷 (Wes Streeting) 在唐宁街与基尔·斯塔默 (Keir Starmer) 举行会谈，卫生部长的盟友再次呼吁首相辞职，称他的权威已“无可挽回地消退”。周三早上，斯特里廷在对工党领导层危机和他自己在党内的未来的激烈猜测中登上了第十位。大约16分钟后他离开，没有对媒体发表评论。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Political leadership crises often highlight the transient nature of power and the intense human desire for influence. Psalm 75:7 reminds us that while human hands may maneuver, it is ultimately 雅伟 who determines who rises and falls. This perspective invites us to look beyond the immediate political drama to the deeper truth of divine sovereignty over all...
reflection.zh: 政治领导层危机常常凸显权力的短暂性以及人类对影响力的强烈渴望。诗篇75:7提醒我们，尽管人类可能进行各种操控，但最终是雅伟决定谁兴谁衰。这一视角邀请我们超越眼前的政治纷争，看到所有地上权柄都服在神主权之下的更深层真理。

verse.textEn: It is God who judges: He brings one down, he exalts another.
verse.textZh: 惟有神断定；他使这人降卑，使那人升高。

It invites us to consider the deeper forces at play in global conflicts, prompting prayer for wisdom and discernment. title.en: Ghana to evacuate 300 from South Africa over anti-immigrant protests
title.zh: 加纳因反移民抗议活动将从南非撤离300人

summary.en: Ghana's foreign minister announced plans to evacuate 300 "distressed" Ghanaian citizens who registered with the embassy in Pretoria, following anti-immigrant protests in South Africa.
summary.zh: 加纳外交部长宣布，在南非发生反移民抗议活动后，计划撤离300名已在比勒陀利亚大使馆登记的“受困”加纳公民。

body.en:
Ghana says it will evacuate 300 citizens from South Africa following a recent wave of protests against foreign nationals.

Foreign Minister Samuel Okudzeto Ablakwa said in a post on X on Tuesday that the Ghanaian president had granted approval for their "immediate evacuation".

He said the "distressed" Ghanaians had registered at the country's embassy in Pretoria to be rescued in response to an advisory by the foreign ministry "following the latest wave of xenophobic attacks".

Last week, South African authorities denied that anyone had been attacked, saying the widely circulated videos were fake.

On Monday, South African President Cyril Ramaphosa said the recent "protests and criminal acts directed at foreign nationals" did not reflect government policy, describing them as "isolated acts of criminality".

He added that South Africa would "regulate migration, secure our borders and enforce our laws".

Thousands of South Africans joined protests against illegal immigration, demanding the mass deportation of undocumented foreign nationals. Protesters say illegal immigration has had an impact on jobs, housing and crime.

On Tuesday, the Ghanaian embassy in South Africa advised nationals to be highly cautious and prioritise their safety by avoiding public gatherings and shut their shops or businesses in the port city of Durban ahead of a protest planned on Wednesday.

Ghana and Nigeria have recently summoned the South African envoys to their respective countries over the mistreatment and harassment of their citizens.

Ghana has also written to the African Union (AU) asking it to discuss the issue, saying it posed a "serious risk to the safety and wellbeing" of Africans in South Africa.

South Africa responded by saying it had "nothing to hide". The government has condemned the circulation of what it called "fake videos and images" described by some as recordings of attacks on foreign nationals.

Other countries that have warned their citizens in South Africa include Kenya, Malawi, Lesotho and Zimbabwe.

According to official figures, South Africa is home to more than three million foreigners, or about 5% of the population, but there are believed to be many more without papers.

Xenophobia has long been an issue in the country and has been accompanied by occasional outbursts of deadly attacks.
body.zh: 加纳表示，在南非最近发生一波针对外国人的抗议活动后，该国将从南非撤离 300 名公民。 外交部长塞缪尔·奥库泽托·阿布拉夸（Samuel Okudzeto Ablakwa）周二在 X 上发帖称，加纳总统已批准他们“立即撤离”。 他说，“陷入困境的”加纳人已在该国驻比勒陀利亚大使馆登记等待获救，以响应外交部“在最新一波仇外袭击之后”发出的建议。 上周，南非当局否认有人遭到袭击，称广为流传的视频是假的。 周一，南非总统西里尔·拉马福萨表示，最近的“针对外国人的抗议和犯罪行为”并不反映政府政策，并将其描述为“孤立的犯罪行为”。 他补充说，南非将“规范移民、保护我们的边境并执行我们的法律”。 数千名南非人参加了反对非法移民的抗议活动，要求大规模驱逐无证外国人。抗议者表示，非法移民对就业、住房和犯罪产生了影响。 周二，加纳驻南非大使馆建议国民高度谨慎，优先考虑安全，避免公众集会，并在周三计划举行的抗议活动之前关闭港口城市德班的商店或企业。 加纳和尼日利亚最近因虐待和骚扰其公民而召见南非驻各自国家特使。 加纳还写信给非洲联盟（AU），要求其讨论这一问题，称这对南非非洲人的“安全和福祉构成严重威胁”。 南非回应称“没有什么可隐瞒的”。政府谴责所谓的“虚假视频和图像”的传播，一些人将其描述为袭击外国人的录音。 其他向南非公民发出警告的国家包括肯尼亚、马拉维、莱索托和津巴布韦。 根据官方数据，南非有超过 300 万外国人，约占总人口的 5%，但据信还有更多的人没有证件。 仇外心理长期以来一直是该国的一个问题，并伴随着偶尔爆发的致命袭击。

reflection.en: The news of Ghanaians needing evacuation due to anti-immigrant protests highlights the pain of not being welcomed in a foreign land. Leviticus 19:33-34 reminds us of the ancient command to treat the stranger among us as one of our own, remembering our shared human experience of vulnerability. This principle calls us to compassion and protection for those...
reflection.zh: 加纳公民因反移民抗议活动需要撤离的消息，凸显了在异乡不受欢迎的痛苦。利未记19:33-34提醒我们古老的诫命，要善待寄居在我们土地上的陌生人，如同本地人一样，并记住我们共同的人类脆弱经历。这一原则呼唤我们对那些流离失所或寻求庇护的人施以怜悯和保护。

verse.textEn: When a foreigner resides among you in your land, do not mistreat them. The foreigner residing among you must be treated as your native-born. Love them as yourself, for you were foreigners in Egypt.
verse.textZh: 若有外人在你们国中和你同居，就不可欺负他。和你们同居的外人，你们要看他如本地人一样，并要爱他如己，因为你们在埃及地也作过寄居的。

title.en: 'Slinging margaritas': FBI head Kash Patel in heated senate exchange over drinking claims
title.zh: “狂饮玛格丽塔”：联邦调查局局长卡什·帕特尔因饮酒指控在参议院激烈交锋

summary.en: Kash Patel, a former FBI head, has initiated a $345 million lawsuit in response to a news article that he claims portrayed his leadership unfavorably, including allegations related to drinking.
summary.zh: 前联邦调查局局长卡什·帕特尔已提起3.45亿美元的诉讼，以回应一篇新闻报道。该报道据称对其领导力进行了负面描述，其中包括与饮酒有关的指控。

body.en:
FBI director Kash Patel angrily lashed out at a Democratic politician at a budget hearing on Wednesday AEST, calling allegations that he drinks excessively on the job and has been unreachable to his staff at times "unequivocally, categorically false".

"I will not be tarnished by baseless allegations and fraudulent statements from the media," Patel told US senator Chris Van Hollen during a testy exchange that began when the Democrat confronted him about a recent article in The Atlantic magazine that painted an unflattering portrait of his leadership of the United States' premier federal law enforcement agency.

Patel has filed a US$250 million ($345 million) lawsuit over the story. The Atlantic has said it stands by its reporting and would vigorously defend against the "meritless lawsuit".

Patel shouted over Van Hollen and sought to turn the tables by accusing him of "slinging margaritas on the taxpayer dime" in El Salvador, a reference to a visit the senator paid last year to Kilmar Abrego Garcia while he was jailed there following his mistaken deportation to the country .

“The only person who has been drinking during the day on the taxpayer dime was you," Patel said.

“Director Patel, come on," Van Hollen said. "These are serious allegations that were made against you."

He at one point asked Patel if he was willing to take a test meant to measure whether a person has a drinking problem, prompting Patel to shoot back, "I’ll take any test you’re willing to take."

After last year's meeting, Van Hollen publicly accused El Salvador’s government of having misrepresented the nature of his encounter with Abrego Garcia, saying officials there had staged the meeting with drinks appearing to be alcohol and angled to set the meeting by a hotel pool.

The testy exchange occurred at an annual US Senate subcommittee budget hearing featuring Patel and other senior law enforcement leaders.

The director used the forum to tout what he described as major crime-fighting achievements since he took the position and received a friendly reception from Republican senators who praised his leadership.

Democrats, by contrast, pressed Patel on headline-generating travel that has blended his professional duties with private leisure — including a trip to the Winter Olympics in Italy, where he partied with the US men's ice hockey team after their gold medal win — as well as the mass terminations of agents who worked on investigations into President Donald Trump.

title.en: Trump's 'Golden Dome' will cost $1.2tn and might not stop all-out missile attack
title.zh: 特朗普的‘金色穹顶’将耗资1.2万亿美元，且可能无法阻止全面导弹袭击

summary.en: An independent budget office has reported that a proposed defense project, dubbed the "Golden Dome," is estimated to cost $1.2 trillion, nearly seven times higher than the initial projection. The report also suggests the system might not be fully effective against an all-out missile attack.
summary.zh: 一个独立预算办公室报告称，一项名为“金色穹顶”的拟议防御项目预计将耗资1.2万亿美元，比最初的估计高出近七倍。报告还指出，该系统可能无法完全抵御全面导弹袭击。

body.en:
US President Donald Trump's futuristic "Golden Dome" missile defence system will cost about $1.2 ​tn (£882bn) to develop, deploy and operate over two decades, the nonpartisan Congressional Budget Office estimates.

That figure is significantly higher than the initial sum of $175bn (£129bn) that had been earmarked.

And the system designed to shield the US against ballistic and cruise missiles might not even work. The new CBO report warned the Golden Dome could be vulnerable to a full-scale attack by Russia or China.

Acquisition costs alone would be ⁠over $1tn, including for the interceptor layers and a space-based missile warning and tracking system, the fiscal scorekeeper said in a new report.

Just days after returning to the White House in January, Trump unveiled plans for the system, aimed at countering "next-generation" aerial threats.

He said last year that the programme would require an initial investment of $25bn, with a total cost of $175bn over time.

Democratic Senator Jeff Merkley, who requested the estimate in the report, said on Tuesday: "The President's so-called 'Golden Dome' is nothing more than a massive giveaway to ​defense contractors paid for entirely by working Americans."

There have been doubts about whether the US would be able to deliver a comprehensive defence system for such a huge land mass.

Officials have warned that existing systems have not kept pace with increasingly sophisticated weapons possessed by potential adversaries.

Despite the projected costs of the Golden Dome, "the system could be overwhelmed by a full-scale attack mounted by a peer or near-peer adversary", the CBO said.

An executive order calling for the creation of what was initially termed the "Iron Dome for America" noted that the threat of next-generation weapons has "become more intense and complex" over time, a potentially "catastrophic" scenario for the US.

A week into his second term, Trump ordered the defence department to submit plans for a system that would deter and defend against aerial attacks, which the White House said at the time remain "the most catastrophic threat" facing the US.

Trump said the system would consist of "next-generation" technologies across land, sea and space, including space-based sensors and interceptors.

The system would be "capable even of intercepting missiles launched from the other side of the world, or launched from space", the president said last year.

SpaceX and Lockheed Martin last month won contracts worth up to $3.2bn to develop space-based missile interceptor prototypes for the system.
body.zh: 无党派国会预算办公室的一份新报告估计，唐纳德·特朗普总统的未来“金顶”导弹防御系统将在二十年的时间里花费约 1.2 万亿美元（8820 亿英镑）来开发、部署和运营。 这一数字明显高于最初指定的 1,750 亿美元（1,292.5 亿英镑）。 该监管机构在周二发布的一份报告中表示，仅采购成本就将超过 1 万亿美元，其中包括拦截层和天基导弹预警和跟踪系统。 “金穹”旨在包围美国，旨在对抗对美国的空中威胁，包括弹道导弹和巡航导弹。 一月份返回白宫几天后，特朗普公布了他的该系统计划，旨在应对“下一代”空中威胁。 他去年表示，该计划需要 250 亿美元的初始投资，随着时间的推移，总成本将达到 1750 亿美元。 要求在报告中提供这一估算的民主党参议员杰夫·默克利周二表示：“总统所谓的‘金顶’只不过是对完全由美国工薪阶层支付的国防承包商的巨大赠品。” 人们一直怀疑美国是否能够为如此大的土地提供全面的防御系统。 官员们警告说，现有系统无法跟上潜在对手拥有的日益先进的武器的步伐。 新的国会预算办公室报告警告称，该系统可能会因俄罗斯或中国发动的全面攻击而“不堪重负”。 一项呼吁建立最初被称为“美国铁穹”的行政命令指出，随着时间的推移，下一代武器的威胁“变得更加强烈和复杂”，这对美国来说可能是“灾难性”的场景。 进入第二任期一周后，特朗普命令国防部提交一套能够威慑和防御空袭的系统计划，白宫当时表示，空袭仍然是美国面临的“最灾难性的威胁”。 特朗普表示，该系统将由跨越陆地、海洋和太空的“下一代”技术组成，包括天基传感器和拦截器。 总统去年表示，该系统“甚至能够拦截从世界另一端或从太空发射的导弹”。

reflection.en: The immense cost and uncertain effectiveness of a proposed defense system highlight the ongoing human struggle for security. Isaiah's vision of beating swords into plowshares offers a profound contrast, inviting us to imagine a world where resources are invested in peace and flourishing rather than in ever more expensive and potentially futile defenses....
reflection.zh: 拟议防御系统的高昂成本和不确定效能，凸显了人类对安全的持续挣扎。以赛亚将刀剑打成犁头的异象提供了一个深刻的对比，邀请我们想象一个将资源投入和平与繁荣，而非投入日益昂贵且可能徒劳的防御系统的世界。这提醒我们，真正的安全最终并非来自军事力量，而是来自被更新的人心和对和解的承诺。

verse.textEn: They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks.
verse.textZh: 他们要将刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀。

title.en: Jason Collins, NBA's first openly gay player, dies aged 47
title.zh: NBA首位公开出柜球员贾森·科林斯享年47岁去世

summary.en: Jason Collins, who made history as the NBA's first openly gay player, has died at the age of 47. He had revealed late last year that he was battling an aggressive form of brain cancer.
summary.zh: 贾森·科林斯，NBA首位公开出柜的球员，于47岁去世。他去年底曾透露自己被诊断出患有侵袭性脑癌。

body.en:
Former pro-basketball player Jason Collins, the first active male athlete on a major American professional team sport to come out as gay, has died aged 47.

Collins died after a "valiant fight with glioblastoma", an aggressive form of brain cancer, his family said in a statement shared by the National Basketball Association (NBA).

He announced last year that he had been diagnosed with the cancer and was undergoing treatment to stop the spread of the inoperable disease.

"Jason Collins' impact and influence extended far beyond basketball as he helped make the NBA, WNBA and larger sports community more inclusive and welcoming for future generations," NBA Commissioner Adam Silver said on Tuesday.

"Jason will be remembered not only for breaking barriers, but also for the kindness and humanity that defined his life and touched so many others," Silver added.

Collins said in December 2025 that the cancer was discovered after he was struggling to focus.

The brain tumour, he said, was like "a monster with tentacles spreading across the underside of my brain the width of a baseball".

When revealing his diagnosis to the world, he said it reminded him of his decision to publicly come out as gay in 2013 in a front-page cover story for Sports Illustrated. The years since were "the best of my life", he said.

"Your life is so much better when you just show up as your true self, unafraid to be your true self, in public or private. This is me. This is what I'm dealing with."

Collins was being treated with a drug called Avastin to slow the tumour's growth, and had been travelling to Singapore for a targeted form of chemotherapy.

The California native started his career in college, playing for Stanford University before going to the NBA. He played for six teams in his 13 seasons in the league, starting with the New Jersey Nets. He had previously been featured on Time Magazine's 100 most influential people list. He retired in 2014.

"Jason changed lives in unexpected ways and was an inspiration to all who knew him and to those who admired him from afar," his family said on Tuesday.

He started his coming out essay for Sports Illustrated in 2013, by writing: "I'm a 34-year-old NBA center. I'm Black and I'm gay."

He was a free agent at the time the essay was published, and so it remained unclear whether coming out would end his NBA career.

While there were significant developments for the gay rights movement by then, gay marriage was not legal across the US until 2015.

Collins went on to rejoin the Nets - where he started his career - after they moved to Brooklyn, and he became the first openly gay athlete to ever play across any of the four major US sports leagues.

body.zh: 前职业篮球运动员贾森·柯林斯 (Jason Collins) 去世，享年 47 岁，他是美国主要职业团队运动中首位公开同性恋身份的现役男运动员。 柯林斯的家人在美国国家篮球协会 (NBA) 分享的一份声明中表示，柯林斯在“与胶质母细胞瘤”（一种侵袭性脑癌）的英勇斗争后去世。 他去年宣布自己被诊断出患有癌症，正在接受治疗以阻止这种无法手术的疾病的传播。 NBA 总裁亚当·萧华 (Adam Silver) 周二表示：“杰森·柯林斯 (Jason Collins) 的影响力远远超出了篮球领域，因为他帮助 NBA、WNBA 和更大的体育界对后代更加包容和欢迎。” 西尔弗补充道：“人们会记住杰森，不仅因为他打破了障碍，而且因为他的善良和人性定义了他的生活并感动了许多人。” 柯林斯于 2025 年 12 月表示，他在难以集中注意力后发现了癌症。 他说，脑瘤就像“一个怪物，触手遍布我的大脑下方，有棒球那么宽”。 当向全世界透露自己的诊断结果时，他说这让他想起了 2013 年在《体育画报》头版封面故事中公开出柜自己同性恋身份的决定。他说，此后的几年是“我一生中最美好的时光”。 “当你展现出真实的自我，无论在公共场合还是私下里，都不害怕做真实的自己，你的生活就会好得多。这就是我。这就是我正在面对的事情。” 柯林斯正在接受一种名为阿瓦斯汀（Avastin）的药物治疗，以减缓肿瘤的生长，并一直前往新加坡接受靶向化疗。 这位土生土长的加州人在大学开始了自己的职业生涯，在进入 NBA 之前曾在斯坦福大学效力。他在联盟的 13 个赛季中效力过 6 支球队，从新泽西网队开始。他此前曾入选《时代》杂志 100 名最具影响力人物名单。他于 2014 年退休。 “杰森以意想不到的方式改变了生活，对所有认识他的人和远方钦佩他的人来说都是一种鼓舞，”他的家人周二表示。 2013 年，他在《体育画报》上发表了自己的出柜文章，开头写道：“我是一名 34 岁的 NBA 中锋。我是黑人，我是同性恋。” 这篇文章发表时，他是一名自由球员，因此目前尚不清楚出柜是否会结束他的 NBA 职业生涯。 虽然当时同性恋权利运动取得了重大进展，但直到 2015 年同性婚姻在美国才合法。 科林斯搬到布鲁克林后，重新加入了篮网队——他在那里开始了自己的职业生涯——他成为第一位在美国四大体育联盟中打球的公开同性恋运动员。 “杰森穿着网队队服度过了八个赛季，帮助定义了我们球队的一个时代......

reflection.en: The news of Jason Collins' passing reminds us of the fragility of life and the battle many face against aggressive illness. Even as our physical bodies may weaken, this verse offers a profound hope that our inner spirit can be renewed daily, finding strength and purpose even in decline. It encourages us to find enduring hope beyond our earthly struggles.
reflection.zh: 贾森·科林斯去世的消息提醒我们生命的脆弱，以及许多人与侵袭性疾病的抗争。即使我们的身体可能衰弱，这节经文也提供了一个深刻的希望，即我们的内在精神可以日复一日地更新，即使在衰退中也能找到力量和目的。它鼓励我们在尘世的挣扎之外找到持久的希望。

verse.textEn: Therefore we do not lose heart. Though outwardly we are wasting away, yet inwardly we are being renewed day by day.
verse.textZh: 所以，我们不丧胆。外体虽然毁坏，内心却一天新似一天。

title.en: Australian Wedgetail spy aircraft to return to the Middle East on Hormuz mission
title.zh: 澳大利亚“楔尾”预警机将重返中东执行霍尔木兹任务

summary.en: Australia is deploying a Wedgetail spy aircraft to the Middle East as part of a mission to assist ships navigating the Strait of Hormuz. This effort, led by the UK and France, involves Australia and 40 other countries working to ensure maritime security in the vital waterway.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚将派遣一架“楔尾”预警机返回中东，执行霍尔木兹海峡任务。这项由英国和法国牵头的行动，旨在协助船只安全通过霍尔木兹海峡，澳大利亚及其他40个国家共同参与，以确保这一重要航道的航运安全。

body.en:
Australia plans to send a high-tech spy plane to bolster multilateral efforts to support the flow of ships through the Strait of Hormuz.

Defence Minister Richard Marles has unveiled plans to contribute the E-7A Wedgetail aircraft after a virtual meeting of international defence ministers on Tuesday.

The aircraft, which is a world-leading early warning and control plane, was initially deployed to the region in March to help defend the United Arab Emirates from Iranian strikes.

At the meeting, Marles and his counterparts from more than 40 countries reaffirmed their efforts to support navigation through the waterway under a joint mission led by the UK and France.

Traffic through the Strait of Hormuz has been reduced to a trickle since conflict began in the region, after the US and Israel launched strikes on Iran on 28 February.

About one-fifth of the world's oil and liquefied natural gas travels through the waterway, over which Iran has asserted control.

Hopes for a peace deal have dwindled after US President Donald Trump said the ceasefire was on "life support" on Monday.

It followed Iran's rejection of a US proposal to end the conflict, as it refuses to budge on a list of demands rejected by Trump.

Marles stressed the multinational mission to support movement through the strait was "strictly defensive".

"Australia stands ready to support an independent and strictly defensive Multinational Military Mission, led by the United Kingdom and France, once it is established," he said.

The multinational operation is designed to complement non-military diplomatic and de-escalation efforts, he added.

"We want to see this conflict end, the Strait of Hormuz open and freedom of navigation resume," Marles said.

"The longer this conflict goes on, the more significant the impact on Australia will be."

Treasurer Jim Chalmers acknowledged the costs of a prolonged war for households and businesses, as he released the federal budget on Tuesday.

"War in the Middle East has been pushing up prices, pushing down growth, and punishing Australians," Chalmers said in his budget speech.

He said Australia was well-placed to weather headwinds from the conflict, however acknowledged high oil prices and corresponding hits to commodities, including fertiliser, could push it to the brink of recession.

body.zh: 澳大利亚计划派遣一架高科技间谍机，以支持多边努力，支持船只通过霍尔木兹海峡。 周二举行的国际国防部长虚拟会议后，国防部长理查德·马尔斯公布了捐赠 E-7A 楔尾飞机的计划。 这架飞机是世界领先的预警和控制飞机，最初于三月份部署到该地区，以帮助保卫阿拉伯联合酋长国免受伊朗的袭击。 会上，马勒斯和40多个国家的同行重申，他们将在英国和法国牵头的联合代表团的领导下，为支持该水道的航行做出努力。 自 2 月 28 日美国和以色列对伊朗发动袭击后，该地区爆发冲突以来，通过霍尔木兹海峡的交通量已减少到极点。 世界上大约五分之一的石油和液化天然气通过这条水道运输，伊朗声称对该水道拥有控制权。 在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周一表示停火已“维持生命”后，达成和平协议的希望已经渺茫。 此前，伊朗拒绝了美国结束冲突的提议，因为它拒绝在特朗普拒绝的一系列要求上让步。 马勒斯强调，支持通过海峡行动的多国任务是“严格防御性的”。 他说：“一旦由英国和法国领导的独立且严格防御的多国军事特派团成立，澳大利亚随时准备支持该特派团。” 他补充说，多国行动旨在补充非军事外交和缓和紧张局势的努力。 马勒斯说：“我们希望看到这场冲突结束，霍尔木兹海峡开放，恢复航行自由。” “这场冲突持续的时间越长，对澳大利亚的影响就越大。” 财政部长吉姆·查默斯在周二公布的联邦预算中承认，长期战争给家庭和企业带来了代价。 查尔默斯在预算演讲中表示：“中东战争推高了物价，抑制了经济增长，并惩罚了澳大利亚人。” 他表示，澳大利亚完全有能力抵御冲突带来的不利影响，但也承认高油价和对化肥等大宗商品的相应打击可能会将其推向衰退的边缘。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: The deployment of international forces to secure a vital shipping lane reflects a collective commitment to maintaining peace and safe passage for all. Such efforts, aimed at preventing conflict and ensuring stability, embody the spirit of peacemaking among nations. When countries work together to foster order, they contribute to a world where all can...
reflection.zh: 国际部队部署以确保重要航运通道的安全，体现了各国对维护和平与安全通行的集体承诺。这些旨在预防冲突和确保稳定的努力，体现了国家间缔造和平的精神。当各国共同努力促进秩序时，它们就为所有人都能安全航行做出了贡献。

verse.textEn: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.
verse.textZh: 使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子。

title.en: Thief jailed after stealing unreleased Beyoncé music from car
title.zh: 窃贼因盗窃碧昂丝未发行音乐被判入狱

summary.en: A man has been jailed after breaking into a car and stealing luggage that contained hard drives with unreleased music by the singer Beyoncé.
summary.zh: 一名男子因闯入汽车并偷走装有歌手碧昂丝未发行音乐硬盘的行李而被判入狱。

body.en:
A man who broke into a car and stole hard drives containing unreleased music by Beyoncé has been sentenced to two years in prison.

Kelvin Evans, 41, pleaded guilty to charges including entering an automobile and criminal trespass last year in Atlanta, Georgia. A judge sentenced him to an additional three years of probation.

Apparently at random, Evans broke into a Jeep Wagoneer rented by a choreographer and dancer for Beyoncé on 8 July 2025, as the singer's Cowboy Carter tour was coming to Atlanta.

The two returned to find the vehicle's rear window smashed and their luggage gone. Investigators have not recovered the hard drives or other stolen items.

Evans struck a plea deal in court on Tuesday ahead of his trial this week, the Fulton County District Attorney's office confirmed to the BBC.

His lawyer told the judge his client was "hoping for a future where he can make money legitimately and be part of society like the rest of us".

Jury selection in the case began on Monday and prosecutors showed surveillance footage of a red Hyundai driven by Evans, pulling up next to the rental car in a parking garage.

Another surveillance video showed the same red Hyundai arriving at an apartment block, with Evans handling suitcases believed to belong to Beyoncé choreographer Christopher Grant and dancer Diandre Blue.

Grant and Blue had told police that the items stolen from their rental car included two MacBook laptops, Apple headphones, luxury clothing and accessories, and hard drives that investigators said contained unreleased Beyoncé material.

Grant also told authorities he was carrying "personal sensitive information" belonging to Beyoncé.

Prosecutors said the stolen laptops had tracking technology that placed the items at the address seen in the second video.

As part of his sentence, Evans has been ordered to stay away from the victims as well as the car park where the theft took place.

The break-in happened just before Beyoncé launched the four-night leg of her Cowboy Carter tour at Atlanta's Mercedes-Benz Stadium.
body.zh: 一名男子闯入汽车并偷走了含有碧昂丝未发行音乐的硬盘，被判处两年监禁。 41 岁的凯尔文·埃文斯 (Kelvin Evans) 承认去年在佐治亚州亚特兰大闯入汽车和非法侵入等罪名。法官又判处他三年缓刑。 2025 年 7 月 8 日，当碧昂斯的牛仔卡特巡演即将前往亚特兰大时，埃文斯显然是随机闯入了一位编舞兼舞者为碧昂斯租用的吉普车。 两人返回后发现汽车后窗被砸碎，行李也不见了。调查人员尚未找回硬盘或其他被盗物品。 富尔顿县地方检察官办公室向 BBC 证实，埃文斯在本周的审判前于周二在法庭上达成了认罪协议。 他的律师告诉法官，他的当事人“希望未来能够合法赚钱，并像我们其他人一样成为社会的一部分”。 该案的陪审团遴选工作于周一开始，检察官展示了埃文斯驾驶的一辆红色现代汽车的监控录像，该车停在停车场的出租汽车旁边。 另一段监控视频显示，同样的红色现代汽车抵达一栋公寓楼，埃文斯正在搬运据信属于碧昂斯编舞克里斯托弗·格兰特和舞者黛安德烈·布鲁的手提箱。 格兰特和布鲁告诉警方，从他们租来的汽车中被盗的物品包括两台 MacBook 笔记本电脑、苹果耳机、豪华服装和配件以及硬盘，调查人员称这些硬盘中包含未发布的碧昂斯材料。 格兰特还告诉当局，他携带了属于碧昂丝的“个人敏感信息”。 检察官表示，被盗笔记本电脑具有跟踪技术，可以将物品放置在第二个视频中看到的地址。 作为判决的一部分，埃文斯被命令远离受害者以及发生盗窃的停车场。 这次闯入事件发生在碧昂斯在亚特兰大梅赛德斯奔驰体育场开始为期四晚的牛仔卡特巡演之前。

reflection.en: The story of stolen unreleased music highlights the temptation to gain wealth or fame through illicit means. When the love of money takes root, it can lead individuals down paths of dishonesty and crime, ultimately bringing sorrow and legal consequences. This reminds us to guard our hearts against greed and pursue integrity in all our dealings.
reflection.zh: 这则关于未发行音乐被盗的故事，凸显了通过非法手段获取财富或名声的诱惑。当贪爱钱财的心生根发芽时，它可能导致个人走上不诚实和犯罪的道路，最终带来悲伤和法律后果。这提醒我们要警惕贪婪，并在所有行为中追求正直。

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
verse.textZh: 贪财是万恶之根。

title.en: 'Devoid of all military logic': Zelenskyy fumes as Russia targets Ukraine civilians
title.zh: 泽连斯基怒斥俄罗斯针对乌克兰平民的袭击“完全不符合军事逻辑”

summary.en: Officials reported that civilians in Ukraine were targeted by Russian attacks, which occurred after a three-day ceasefire that marked the Soviet victory in World War Two. Ukrainian President Zelenskyy condemned the actions as lacking any military justification.
summary.zh: 官员报告称，俄罗斯在纪念苏联二战胜利的三天停火结束后，对乌克兰平民发动了袭击。乌克兰总统泽连斯基谴责这些行动“完全不符合军事逻辑”。

body.en:
Russian forces have launched attacks in Ukraine's Dnipropetrovsk ‌region, killing at least six people, after the expiry of a US-mediated ceasefire.

Ukrainian officials said Russia launched ‌more than 200 drones overnight on Tuesday, putting an end to hopes that the three-day ceasefire that ended on Monday would be extended.

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, ‌meanwhile, said his country's forces had struck gas facilities in Russia's central Orenburg region, more than 1500km from its borders.

A drone attack on an apartment building in Zelenskyy's hometown, the central Ukrainian city of Kryvyi Rih, killed two and injured four, including the dead couple's nine-month-old granddaughter, regional governor Oleksandr Hanzha and the head of the military administration, Oleksandr Vilkul, said on Telegram.

Zelenskyy, also writing ‌on X, denounced ⁠the strike as "cynical and devoid of all military logic".

"After the end of the partial three-day ceasefire, Russia continues to kill and maim Ukrainians and pressure on it must therefore in no way be weakened," he said.

North-east of Kryvyi Rih, an aerial bomb strike killed four and injured three, Hanzha said.

Ukraine and Russia had agreed to the ceasefire linked to the anniversary of the Soviet victory over Nazi Germany in World War Two, part of a US-led push for peace under ⁠President Donald Trump after more than four years of war.

Although neither side reported large-scale airstrikes during the ceasefire, both said fighting continued along the front line, accusing each ‌other of drone and artillery attacks.

Zelenskyy, speaking in his nightly video address, said Ukraine was working with its allies in Europe to develop technologies to defend against ballistic missiles, adding that 13 countries and NATO representatives had participated in talks on the issue on Tuesday.

For the latest from SBS News, download our app and subscribe to our newsletter .
body.zh: 在美国斡旋的停火协议到期后，俄罗斯军队对乌克兰第聂伯罗彼得罗夫斯克地区发动袭击，造成至少六人死亡。 乌克兰官员表示，俄罗斯周二夜间发射了 200 多架无人机，使周一结束的为期三天的停火协议得以延长的希望破灭。 与此同时，乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基表示，乌克兰军队袭击了俄罗斯中部奥伦堡地区的天然气设施，该地区距离俄罗斯边境 1500 多公里。 泽伦斯基家乡乌克兰中部城市克里沃罗格的一栋公寓楼遭到无人机袭击，造成两人死亡、四人受伤，其中包括死者夫妇九个月大的孙女、地区州长奥列克桑德尔·汉扎 (Oleksandr Hanzha) 和军政府负责人奥列克桑德尔·维尔库尔 (Oleksandr Vilkul) 在 Telegram 上表示。 泽伦斯基也在 X 上撰文，谴责此次袭击“愤世嫉俗，缺乏军事逻辑”。 他说：“三天部分停火结束后，俄罗斯继续杀害和残害乌克兰人，因此决不能削弱对其施加的压力。” 汉扎说，克里沃罗格东北部的一次空袭造成四人死亡、三人受伤。 乌克兰和俄罗斯同意在第二次世界大战中苏联战胜纳粹德国周年纪念日期间停火，这是唐纳德·特朗普总统领导下的美国在四年多的战争后推动和平的一部分。 尽管停火期间双方都没有报告大规模空袭，但双方都表示前线战斗仍在继续，并互相指责对方发动无人机和炮兵袭击。 泽连斯基在夜间视频讲话中表示，乌克兰正在与其欧洲盟国合作开发防御弹道导弹的技术，并补充说有 13 个国家和北约代表参加了周二有关该问题的会谈。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: The targeting of civilians in conflict brings immense sorrow and pain, reminding us of the deep brokenness in our world. Yet, even amidst such profound suffering, we hold onto the hope of a future where God promises to wipe away every tear and end all pain. This promise offers solace and a vision of ultimate peace beyond present tragedies.
reflection.zh: 冲突中针对平民的袭击带来了巨大的悲伤和痛苦，提醒我们世界深层的破碎。然而，即使在如此深重的苦难中，我们仍怀抱对未来的盼望，那时雅伟应许要擦去一切眼泪，止息所有痛苦。这个应许在当前的悲剧中给予我们慰藉，并指向最终的和平。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: Air India crisis deepens ahead of final Ahmedabad crash report
title.zh: 印度航空危机在艾哈迈达巴德坠机事故最终报告发布前加剧

summary.en: Air India is currently facing significant challenges, including a leadership vacuum and increasing financial losses, as it works to recover from a past crash. These issues are surfacing ahead of the final report on the Ahmedabad crash.
summary.zh: 印度航空公司目前正面临严峻挑战，包括领导层真空和不断增加的财务损失，该公司正努力从一次坠机事故中恢复。这些问题在艾哈迈达巴德坠机事故的最终报告发布前浮出水面。

body.en:
In under a month from now, India's Aircraft Accident Investigation Bureau (AAIB) is expected to release its final report on the crash of London-bound Air India flight AI‑171 that went down seconds after take‑off from Ahmedabad in western India on 12 June 2025.

As the world awaits the findings on the devastating tragedy that claimed 260 lives, a cascade of formidable challenges has deepened the crisis at Air India.

A leadership vacuum, mounting financial losses , airspace closures and a Middle Eastern fuel shock have put the carrier's ambitious turnaround into question. A spate of recent incidents have also cast a shadow on the safety and operational track record of the airline.

Last month, Air India's chief executive officer, Campbell Wilson, resigned midterm as losses for the year ending March 2026 reportedly hit $2.4bn.

Air India is currently the biggest loss-making entity within the Tata Group - which took over the ailing carrier from the government in 2022 - and a point of growing consternation for the Tata board.

According to local media, the board met last week and is said to have discussed several cost-cutting measures and warned staff of "tough times" . The arrival of senior Singapore Airlines leadership at the group's headquarters in Mumbai city in April, meanwhile, sparked talks of the latter deepening its involvement in the beleaguered carrier. Singapore Airlines is a 25.1% shareholder in Air India.

Air India said it would not comment on the BBC's detailed questionnaire, but aviation experts say Wilson's exit creates a void at a time when the airline desperately needs someone to steer it through the turbulence.

"They needed a clear vision right now. Air India had given itself a five-year plan to revamp itself after the privatisation. But one can't really say that it's been a happy ride so far. Between their plan and its implementation, there have been big and growing gaps," Jitendra Bhargava, a former executive director at Air India, told the BBC.

Bhargava points to internal and external factors that have compounded the airline's troubles even as it tries to recover from the Ahmedabad crash.

He says the Tatas had "underestimated the problems they inherited with the legacy carrier", and Wilson was unable to build a team quickly enough after coming in to set things in order.

Far from improving its brand image, Air India has had to continue answering for an array of embarrassing operational lapses and safety violations in the past year.

In March, its flight from Delhi to Vancouver was forced to return to the Indian capital after flying for nearly eight hours because it did not have regulatory approval to enter Canadian airspace.

Air India merely cited operational reasons for the goof-up but Alok Anand of Acumen Aviation...
body.zh: 从现在起不到一个月的时间，印度飞机事故调查局 (AAIB) 预计将发布关于印度航空 AI-171 航班飞往伦敦的事故的最终报告，该航班于 2025 年 6 月 12 日从印度西部艾哈迈达巴德起飞后几秒钟坠毁。 当全世界都在等待这场夺走 260 人生命的毁灭性悲剧的调查结果时，一系列严峻的挑战加剧了印度航空的危机。 领导层真空、不断增加的财务损失、空域关闭和中东燃油冲击使该航空公司雄心勃勃的转型之路受到质疑。最近发生的一系列事件也给该航空公司的安全和运营记录蒙上了阴影。 上个月，印度航空首席执行官坎贝尔·威尔逊 (Campbell Wilson) 在中期辞职，因为据报道截至 2026 年 3 月的财年亏损达 24 亿美元。 印度航空目前是塔塔集团内最大的亏损实体，塔塔集团于 2022 年从政府手中接管了这家陷入困境的航空公司，这也是塔塔董事会日益感到震惊的一个问题。 据当地媒体报道，董事会上周举行会议，据说讨论了多项削减成本的措施，并警告员工“艰难时期”。与此同时，新加坡航空高级领导层于四月份抵达该集团位于孟买市的总部，引发了有关后者加深对这家陷入困境的航空公司的参与的讨论。新加坡航空持有印度航空25.1%的股份。 印度航空表示不会对英国广播公司的详细调查问卷发表评论，但航空专家表示，在该航空公司迫切需要有人引导其度过动荡之际，威尔逊的退出造成了空白。 印度航空前执行董事 Jitendra Bhargava 告诉 BBC：“他们现在需要一个清晰的愿景。印度航空给自己制定了私有化后的五年改造计划。但到目前为止，还不能说这是一段愉快的旅程。他们的计划与实施之间存在着巨大且不断扩大的差距。” 巴尔加瓦指出，尽管该航空公司试图从艾哈迈达巴德空难中恢复过来，但内部和外部因素却加剧了该航空公司的麻烦。 他表示，塔塔家族“低估了他们从这家传统航空公司继承下来的问题”，而威尔逊在上任后未能足够快地组建一支团队，让一切井井有条。 印度航空非但没有改善其品牌形象，反而不得不继续对过去一年中一系列令人尴尬的运营失误和安全违规行为负责。 今年3月，其从德里飞往温哥华的航班在飞行近8个小时后被迫返回印度首都，因为该航班没有获得进入加拿大领空的监管批准。 印度航空只是援引了此次失误的运营原因，但 Acumen Aviation 的阿洛克·阿南德 (Alok Anand)...

reflection.en: A leadership vacuum can leave any organization adrift, especially when navigating a crisis and significant financial strain. Proverbs reminds us that without wise guidance, even a nation can falter, highlighting the critical need for sound counsel to find stability and safety.
reflection.zh: 领导层真空可能使任何组织陷入困境，尤其是在应对危机和巨大财务压力时。箴言提醒我们，没有明智的指导，即使是国家也会衰落，这突显了在寻求稳定和安全时，健全的建议至关重要。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: As his China trip begins, Trump insists he doesn't need Xi's help on Iran
title.zh: 特朗普中国之行启动，坚称在伊朗问题上不需要习近平的帮助

summary.en: Donald Trump is set to meet Chinese president Xi Jinping for high-stakes talks on Friday and Saturday.
summary.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普定于周五和周六与中国国家主席习近平举行高层会谈。

body.en:
Donald Trump was due to arrive in Beijing on Wednesday, the first visit to China by a US president in nearly a decade, as he seeks to ramp up trade despite potential friction over Taiwan and Iran.

Leaving Washington DC on Wednesday on a trip that was delayed by his war, Trump said he expected a "long talk" with counterpart Xi Jinping about Iran, which relies on China as the top customer for its US-sanctioned oil.

But he also played down disagreements on Iran, saying that Xi has been "relatively good, to be honest with you".

"I don't think we need any help with Iran. We'll win it one way or the other. We'll win it peacefully or otherwise," Trump told reporters as he left the White House.

This week's trip — the first since Trump visited in 2017 — will involve high-stakes talks with Xi on Friday and Saturday, during a packed itinerary that includes a state banquet and tea reception.

Trump said on Tuesday that he would speak to Xi about US arms sales to Taiwan, the self-governing island claimed by China — a departure from historic US insistence that it will not consult China on its support to the island.

China's controls on rare earth exports and the countries' raucous trade relationship are among the topics expected to be taken up by the heads of the world's top two economies.

The tense buildup to the superpower summit was already visible on Wednesday on the streets of Beijing, with police monitoring major intersections and checking the ID cards of passengers on the metro, Agence France-Presse (AFP) journalists saw.

"It's definitely a big deal," said Wen Wen, a 24-year-old woman travelling from the eastern city of Nanjing, when asked by AFP about Trump's visit.

"Some progress will certainly be made," she said, noting that she hopes China and the United States can ensure "lasting peace" despite "recent instability in the global situation".

Trade ties between China and the US have been fraught in recent years. The two sides are currently maintaining a one-year truce in their tariff war reached at Trump and Xi's last meeting in South Korea in October.

China's major surplus in trade with the United States has long irritated Trump, who slapped tariffs on the country's goods during his first term in office.

Trump will be accompanied in China by a large group of top US business executives, including Tesla's Elon Musk and Apple's Tim Cook, the White House has said.

The highly anticipated summit comes at an uncertain time for China's economy, which has struggled in recent years with sluggish domestic spending and a protracted debt crisis in the once-booming property sector.

For Li Jiahao, 30, who manages a Beijing karaoke bar, the summit will not necessarily solve all problems in China-US relations — though he is hoping...
body.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普定于周三抵达北京，这是美国总统近十年来首次访问中国，尽管台湾和伊朗问题可能存在摩擦，但他仍寻求扩大贸易。 特朗普周三离开华盛顿特区，开始他因战争而推迟的行程，他表示，他预计与习近平就伊朗问题进行“长谈”，伊朗依赖中国作为美国制裁石油的最大客户。 但他也淡化了在伊朗问题上的分歧，称习近平“老实说，相对不错”。 “我认为我们在伊朗问题上不需要任何帮助。我们会以一种或另一种方式赢得它。我们会以和平或其他方式赢得它，”特朗普在离开白宫时告诉记者。 本周的访问是特朗普自 2017 年访问以来的首次访问，周五和周六将与习近平进行高风险会谈，行程紧凑，包括国宴和茶会。 特朗普周二表示，他将与习近平讨论美国向中国声称拥有主权的台湾岛出售武器的问题，这与美国历来坚称不会就对台湾岛的支持问题征求中国意见的立场背道而驰。 中国对稀土出口的控制以及两国紧张的贸易关系预计将成为世界两大经济体领导人讨论的话题。 法新社记者看到，周三，北京街头已经出现了超级大国峰会的紧张气氛，警察监视着主要十字路口，并检查地铁乘客的身份证。 “这绝对是一件大事，”来自东部城市南京的 24 岁女性文文在被法新社问及特朗普的访问时说。 “肯定会取得一些进展，”她说，并指出，尽管“全球局势最近不稳定”，但她希望中国和美国能够确保“持久和平”。 近年来，中美之间的贸易关系充满挑战。两国目前正在维持特朗普和习近平十月份在韩国举行最后一次会晤时达成的为期一年的关税战停战协议。 中国对美国的巨额贸易顺差长期以来一直激怒特朗普，他在第一个任期内对中国商品征收关税。 白宫表示，特朗普将由一大批美国企业高管陪同访问中国，其中包括特斯拉的埃隆·马斯克和苹果的蒂姆·库克。 此次备受期待的峰会召开之际，中国经济正处于一个不确定的时期。近年来，中国经济因国内支出低迷和一度繁荣的房地产行业长期债务危机而陷入困境。 对于经营北京一家卡拉 OK 店的 30 岁李家豪来说，此次峰会不一定能解决中美关系中的所有问题——尽管他希望……

reflection.en: In high-stakes diplomatic meetings, every word carries weight and shapes the path forward. This verse reminds us that our speech, especially in public and sensitive contexts, should be gracious and wise, aiming for understanding and effective engagement. May leaders be guided to communicate in ways that build bridges and foster peaceful resolutions.
reflection.zh: 在事关重大的外交会谈中，每句话都举足轻重，影响着未来的走向。这节经文提醒我们，我们的言语，尤其是在公开和敏感场合，应带着恩典和智慧，旨在促进理解和有效的互动。愿领袖们蒙引导，以建立桥梁、促成和平解决的方式进行沟通。

verse.textEn: Let your conversation be always full of grace, seasoned with salt.
verse.textZh: 你们的言语要常常带着和气，好像用盐调和。

title.en: Iran: Surge of political prisoners amid US-Israel war
title.zh: 伊朗：美以战争期间政治犯激增

summary.en: Amid the US-Israel war with Iran, as the world breathlessly watches the Strait of Hormuz, Tehran is quietly increasing pressure on political prisoners. Advocates are sounding the alarm, warning of mass executions.
summary.zh: 在美以与伊朗的战争中，当全世界屏息关注霍尔木兹海峡之际，德黑兰正在悄然加大对政治犯的施压。倡导者们正在发出警报，警告可能发生大规模处决。

body.zh: 在美以与伊朗的战争中，当全世界屏息凝视霍尔木兹海峡时，德黑兰正在悄悄加大对政治犯的压力。支持者拉响警报，警告大规模处决。 马哈茂德·阿米里-莫格达姆告诉德国之声：“我们一直非常关注伊朗的人权状况。” 这位挪威裔伊朗神经科学家是非政府组织伊朗人权组织的创始人。 “几乎每天都有政治犯、抗议者和被指控从事间谍活动的人被处决，这尤其令人震惊，”他补充道。 他的组织发现，2025年，伊朗至少处决了1,639人，比前一年增加了68%，平均每天处决四到五人。 自二月份最近的美以与伊朗战争爆发以来，这个中东国家已成为全球政治的焦点。大多数注意力都集中在地缘政治问题上，尤其是霍尔木兹海峡，在封锁之前，世界上大约四分之一的原油和石油产品是通过该海峡运输的。然而与此同时，伊朗的内政却普遍被忽视。 阿米尔-莫加达姆说：“在国际社会很少关注伊朗侵犯人权的情况下，伊朗伊斯兰共和国正在利用额外的余地处决囚犯，同时尽可能降低政治成本。” 2025 年处决人数创 35 年来最高，是 2022 年全国“妇女、生命、自由”抗议活动后开始激增的延续。人们现在谈论的是一种恐惧的气氛。 自美以与伊朗战争爆发以来，联合国人权事务高级专员沃尔克·蒂尔克表示，已有 4,000 多人因与国家安全相关的指控在伊朗被捕。其中，至少 21 人已被处决。 “我几乎不敢想象过去几天的连续处决对监狱政治区的气氛造成了怎样的影响，”X 用户 Sayed Ziaddin Nabavi（又名 Zia Nabavi）写道。尽管受到严重限制，这位受欢迎的人权活动家是少数仍然偶尔活跃在社交媒体上的人之一。 自 2 月下旬以来，由于政府对 VPN 连接和卫星终端采取了更多行动，以规避国家审查，因此互联网访问受到严重干扰。这使得国内以及国外的沟通变得更加困难。 人权律师赛义德表示：“通过与伊朗同事的合作——联系他们非常困难——我们了解到政治犯的法庭案件正在加速，同时也变得越来越不透明。”

reflection.en: The news of increased pressure on political prisoners reminds us of the profound vulnerability of those under oppressive regimes. This verse powerfully describes the danger faced by a helpless people when rulers act without justice or mercy. It calls us to remember those who suffer under such conditions and to pray for their protection and for righteous...
reflection.zh: 政治犯所面临的压力日益增加的消息，提醒我们那些在压迫政权下的人们是多么脆弱。这节经文有力地描述了当统治者缺乏公义和怜悯时，无助的人民所面临的危险。它呼吁我们记念那些在如此境况下受苦的人，并为他们的保护和公义的治理祷告。

verse.textEn: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a helpless people.
verse.textZh: 暴虐的君王辖制贫民，好像吼叫的狮子、觅食的熊。

title.en: EU invites Taliban members to discuss Afghan migrant returns
title.zh: 欧盟邀请塔利班成员讨论阿富汗移民遣返问题

summary.en: The European Commission has extended an invitation to officials from Afghanistan's Taliban to engage in discussions regarding the repatriation of certain migrants. This move is considered controversial due to humanitarian concerns and the fact that Brussels does not officially recognize the Taliban's authority.
summary.zh: 欧盟委员会已邀请阿富汗塔利班官员讨论部分移民的遣返问题。此举因人道主义考量以及布鲁塞尔不承认塔利班政权而备受争议。

body.zh: 欧盟委员会已邀请阿富汗塔利班官员讨论某些移民的返回问题。这在人道主义方面存在争议，而且因为布鲁塞尔不承认塔利班的权威。 欧盟委员会已邀请塔利班代表前往布鲁塞尔就驱逐被拒绝留在欧盟的阿富汗国民问题进行会谈。 欧盟委员会发言人马库斯·拉默特周二表示，在发出邀请之前，今年一月在阿富汗举行了一次“技术会谈”初步会议，并将计划中的布鲁塞尔讨论列为“后续会议”。 他表示，对布鲁塞尔的邀请“无论如何并不构成对塔利班作为阿富汗政府的承认”。 五年前的 2021 年初，塔利班在北约撤军中突然重新掌权，但欧盟并未正式承认塔利班的领导地位。 欧盟委员会发言人拉默特表示，20个欧盟成员国和申根国家最初于去年提出了磋商请求。 发起请愿的国家抱怨说，欧盟国家在2024年发出遣返令的阿富汗人中，实际上只有2%被遣返。 拉默特表示，大多数人要么被定罪，要么被视为安全威胁，或者两者兼而有之。 “我们在这里谈论的是构成安全威胁的人。这些人是成员国希望遣返的人，”拉默特说。 在欧盟委员会官员与瑞典合作后，周二上午发出了一封信，寻求确定会谈日期。 瑞典和德国一直是推动在这一问题上采取行动的国家之一，在德国，一名阿富汗国民遭受了备受瞩目的持刀袭击，这名阿富汗国民此前被勒令离开该国，这在 2025 年联邦选举周期的最后几周成为新闻焦点。 鉴于阿富汗的安全局势，特别是自塔利班于 2021 年重新掌权以来，欧洲国家一直在政治和法律上努力将移民遣返该国。 伊斯兰主义者在国际上基本上被孤立，尽管越来越多的政府倾向于部分承认和合作，尤其是因为他们对妇女和女孩的限制。 2024年，欧洲法院（ECJ）裁定塔利班对待妇女的方式构成迫害。 拉默特说：“每项遣返决定都必须符合欧盟和国际法，特别是基本权利。” 据联合国难民署称，自 2023 年 10 月以来，巴基斯坦和伊朗等国已驱逐了超过 500 万阿富汗人，其中许多人并非自愿。非政府组织报告说，许多人居住在...

title.en: War in Iran: Despite Iranian attacks, Doha steps up mediation efforts
title.zh: 伊朗战争：尽管伊朗袭击，多哈仍加紧调解努力

summary.en: Qatar is intensifying regional mediation efforts despite the Iran war bringing airstrikes and cutting off Doha's access to global oil markets. Analysts question if Qatar can leverage its ties to the US and Iran for its own benefit.
summary.zh: 尽管伊朗战争带来了空袭并切断了多哈进入全球石油市场的通道，卡塔尔仍在加紧区域调解努力。分析人士质疑卡塔尔能否利用其与美国和伊朗的关系来谋取自身利益。

body.en:
Qatar is intensifying regional mediation efforts despite the Iran war bringing airstrikes and cutting off Doha's access to global oil markets. But can Qatar leverage its ties to the US and Iran for its own benefit?

In Qatar's capital Doha, mediation efforts between the United States  and Iran have been running at a clip. In recent days, Qatari Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani has held calls with officials in Iran , Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, Turkey , Kuwait  and others to discuss "regional tensions" and "efforts aimed at de-escalation in the region."

Last week and during the weekend, Al Thani also met US Vice President JD Vance , US Secretary of State Marco Rubio and White House envoy Steve Witkoff as part of efforts to permanently end the war with Iran , according to the news outlet Axios .

While the Qatari prime minister has repeatedly said Doha fully supports Pakistan's leading mediation role, this appears to show the Gulf state is increasingly expanding its own diplomatic outreach.

"Qatar is playing a vital behind-the-scenes role," Sanam Vakil, director of the Middle East and North Africa Programme at the London-based think tank Chatham House, told DW.

"They are key in bridging divides between Tehran  and Washington despite the war and the Iranian strikes ," she said, adding that Doha has still good ties with the Trump administration and is playing effectively what is a complementary mediation role.

This view is echoed by US officials who said, according to Axios, that Qataris had been "especially effective in negotiations in Iran."

Anna Jacobs, a Gulf analyst and non-resident fellow at the Washington-based think tank Arab Gulf States Institute (AGSI), also points out that "Qatar has a longer history and experience of US and Iran mediation, as well as intimate knowledge of the Gulf regional security landscape in ways that Pakistan just doesn't."

In her view, the US will want to lean more toward Qatari mediation with Iran moving forward.

Successful mediation between the US and Iran would also deliver domestic gains for Qatar.

"Doha's mediation efforts prioritize de-escalation as well as reaching a workable agreement between the US and Iran that could keep the Strait of Hormuz open and safe for commercial shipping ," Jacobs told DW.

The small Gulf state, a close US ally, was heavily targeted by Iranian missiles and drones following the US-Israeli strikes on Iran in late February. Qatar has hosted Al Udeid Air Base — the largest US military base in the Middle East — outside Doha, since 2001.

body.zh: 尽管伊朗战争带来了空袭并切断了多哈进入全球石油市场的通道，但卡塔尔仍在加强地区调解努力。但卡塔尔能否利用与美国和伊朗的关系来谋取自身利益呢？ 在卡塔尔首都多哈，美国和伊朗之间的调解努力一直在快速进行。最近几天，卡塔尔首相兼外交部长谢赫·穆罕默德·本·阿卜杜拉赫曼·阿勒萨尼与伊朗、沙特阿拉伯、巴基斯坦、土耳其、科威特等国官员举行了电话会议，讨论“地区紧张局势”和“旨在缓和该地区局势的努力”。 据新闻媒体 Axios 报道，上周和周末，阿勒萨尼还会见了美国副总统万斯、美国国务卿马可·卢比奥和白宫特使史蒂夫·威特科夫，作为永久结束与伊朗战争的努力的一部分。 尽管卡塔尔总理一再表示多哈完全支持巴基斯坦发挥主导调解作用，但这似乎表明这个海湾国家正在日益扩大自己的外交范围。 伦敦智库查塔姆研究所中东和北非项目主任萨南·瓦基尔 (Sanam Vakil) 告诉德国之声：“卡塔尔在幕后发挥着至关重要的作用。” 她说：“尽管发生了战争和伊朗的袭击，它们仍然是弥合德黑兰和华盛顿之间分歧的关键。”她补充说，多哈仍然与特朗普政府保持着良好的关系，并有效地发挥着补充性的调解作用。 据 Axios 报道，美国官员也赞同这一观点，他们表示，卡塔尔人“在伊朗谈判中特别有效”。 华盛顿智库阿拉伯海湾国家研究所（AGSI）的海湾问题分析师、非常驻研究员安娜·雅各布斯（Anna Jacobs）也指出，“卡塔尔在美国和伊朗调解方面拥有悠久的历史和经验，并且对海湾地区安全格局有着深入的了解，而巴基斯坦却没有。” 在她看来，美国将希望更多地倾向于卡塔尔对伊朗进行调解。 美国和伊朗之间的成功调解也将为卡塔尔带来国内收益。 雅各布斯告诉德国之声：“多哈的调解努力优先考虑缓和局势，以及美国和伊朗之间达成一项可行的协议，以保持霍尔木兹海峡的开放和商业航运的安全。” 这个海湾小国是美国的亲密盟友，自二月底美以对伊朗发动袭击后，这个海湾小国就成为伊朗导弹和无人机的重点攻击目标。自 2001 年以来，卡塔尔在多哈郊外设立了乌代德空军基地，这是美国在中东最大的军事基地。 伊朗袭击其主要天然气设施拉斯拉凡后，全球第二大液化天然气 (LNG) 生产国卡塔尔也不得不于 3 月份暂停生产。多哈还...

reflection.en: In a world often marked by conflict, the act of mediation is a vital ministry of reconciliation. Even when facing direct threats and economic challenges, pursuing peace reflects a commitment to bridging divides. This effort reminds us that working towards harmony, even amidst self-interest, can serve a higher purpose of bringing estranged parties together.
reflection.zh: 在一个常被冲突困扰的世界里，调解行动是一项重要的和好事工。即使面对直接威胁和经济挑战，追求和平也体现了弥合分歧的决心。这项努力提醒我们，即使在自身利益的考量中，为和谐而努力也能服务于一个更高的目的，即让疏远的各方走到一起。

verse.textEn: All this is from God, who reconciled us to himself through Christ and gave us the ministry of reconciliation.
verse.textZh: 这一切都是出于神；他借着基督使我们与他和好，又将劝人与他和好的职分赐给我们。

title.en: US-China summit could reshape global power
title.zh: 美中峰会或将重塑全球力量格局

summary.en: US President Donald Trump is preparing for a summit with China's Xi Jinping in Beijing, aiming for a foreign policy success. Key topics on the agenda include the Iran war, trade agreements, and the issue of Taiwan, with the potential to significantly alter global power dynamics.
summary.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普正准备在北京与中国国家主席习近平举行峰会，希望在外交政策上取得成功。伊朗战争、贸易协议和台湾问题预计将是此次访问的重要议题，此次峰会可能重塑全球力量格局。

body.en:
US President Donald Trump is hoping for a foreign policy win at the upcoming summit with China's Xi Jinping. The Iran war, trade deals and Taiwan are expected to be high on the agenda during Trump's visit to Beijing.

"Good things take time," as the old saying goes. After postponing his trip in March — having just recently launched the war with Iran — US President Donald Trump is set to visit China's leader Xi Jinping in Beijing at the end of the week.

The meeting comes as the world faces an ongoing energy crisis due to the Strait of Hormuz blockade and peace negotiations between Tehran and Washington seem to be deadlocked. Meanwhile, entrenched trade disputes between China and the US still lurk from behind the scenes.

Against this backdrop, both countries have an incentive to ensure the meeting between the two leaders comes off as a success. Neither Trump nor Xi are ready to lose face. Both want to remain the "strong man."

"Trump desperately needs some good news on the foreign policy front," said Chu Yin, a political scientist at the Beijing-based Pangoal think tank and a former professor at the Beijing University of International Relations.

"Trump's poll numbers are in the gutter ahead of the midterm elections in November. Apparently, his plan to quickly bring Iran — an ally of China — to its knees through 'preemptive' military strikes, celebrate his triumph in Beijing, and use it as a bargaining chip, did not work out," Chu told DW.

Chu added that Trump must now pin his hopes on reaching at least a partial agreement in the trade war he himself launched last year with a scattershot tariff regime . Ahead of the meeting, negotiators from both countries will seek to make progress on concrete agreements during talks in Seoul, South Korea.

If nothing else, Trump can rely on  China for pomp and praise. After all, Beijing does not want to embarrass its own president — who has been firmly in power for 13 years — by failing to deliver on ceremony.

Trump also told reporters he would speak to Xi about releasing Hong Kong media mogul and prominent pro-democracy figure Jimmy Lai, who was sentenced to 20 years in prison under a draconian national security law imposed by Beijing.

"Jimmy Lai — he caused lots of turmoil for China. He tried to do the right thing. He wasn't successful, went to jail, and people would like him out, and I'd like to see him out, too," Trump said on Monday

In Beijing's view, the question of Taiwan's legal status is a red line that must not be crossed in diplomatic relations with the United States.

body.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普希望在即将与中国习近平举行的峰会上取得外交政策胜利。伊朗战争、贸易协议和台湾问题预计将成为特朗普访华期间的重要议题。 正如一句老话所说，“好事需要时间”。美国总统唐纳德·特朗普因最近刚刚发动与伊朗的战争而推迟了三月份的访问，他将于本周末在北京会见中国领导人习近平。 这次会议召开之际，由于霍尔木兹海峡封锁，世界面临持续的能源危机，德黑兰和华盛顿之间的和平谈判似乎陷入僵局。与此同时，中美之间根深蒂固的贸易争端仍然潜伏在幕后。 在此背景下，两国都有动力确保两国领导人的会晤取得成功。 特朗普和习近平都没有准备好丢面子。两人都想保持“强者”的身份。 “特朗普在外交政策方面迫切需要一些好消息，”北京盘古智库政治学家、北京国际关系学院前教授褚寅表示。 “在11月中期选举之前，特朗普的民意支持率已经陷入低谷。显然，他通过‘先发制人’的军事打击迅速让中国的盟友伊朗屈服、庆祝他在北京的胜利并以此作为讨价还价筹码的计划并没有成功，”朱告诉德国之声。 朱补充说，特朗普现在必须寄希望于在他自己去年以漫无目的的关税制度发起的贸易战中至少达成部分协议。 会议之前，两国谈判代表将在韩国首尔举行的会谈中寻求就具体协议取得进展。 如果不出意外的话，特朗普可以依靠中国的盛况和赞扬。毕竟，北京不想因为未能兑现承诺而让已经牢牢掌权13年的自己的总统感到尴尬。 特朗普还告诉记者，他将与习近平讨论释放香港媒体大亨和著名民主人士黎智英的事宜，黎智英根据北京实施的严厉国家安全法被判处 20 年监禁。 “黎智英——他给中国造成了很多动荡。他试图做正确的事。但他没有成功，进了监狱，人们希望他出狱，我也希望看到他出狱，”特朗普周一表示。 北京认为，台湾的法律地位问题是中美外交关系中不得跨越的红线。 北京将台湾视为毛泽东于 1949 年创立的中华人民共和国 (PRC) 的一部分。然而，这个民主管理的岛屿在中华人民共和国宪法下正式运作。

body.en:
President Donald Trump is expected to address the Iran war, trade and Taiwan in talks with China's Xi Jinping. DW has more.

Welcome to DW's coverage of the Trump-Xi summit in Beijing on May 13, May 14 and May 15.

China and the US held "candid, in-depth and constructive ‌exchanges" ⁠in ⁠South Korea on resolving trade ​and economic issues and ​expanding cooperation, China's state-run ​Xinhua ‌news agency reported.

US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent ‌and ​Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng had three hours of talks in Seoul to prepare for a summit between Donald Trump and Xi Jinping in China. 

US and Chinese officials did not give an immediate summary of what the discussions entailed. Bessent is due to join Trump in Beijing later on Wednesday.

Both Bessent and He also held separate meetings with South Korean President Lee Jae Myung at the presidential Blue House.

Donald Trump has been to China before as president of the US but that was in 2017 during his first term in office.

At that meeting, Trump lavished praise on Chinese leader Xi Jinping, marking a stark contrast to his previous criticism of China. Xi also gave Trump a spectacular reception, with the visit remembered for years to come.

Trade was a flashpoint issue then, too. Trump has long accused China of unfair trade practices, while the Chinese argument has been that the relationship has benefited Americans in the form of cheap goods and increased Chinese investment in the US.

In 2017, Trump asked Xi to "work very hard" on persuading North Korea to denuclearize. Overall, both sides were cordial. Trump then met Xi Jinping in summits in 2018 and 2019. 

Trump, in his second term, met Xi for the first time in October 2025 in South Korea, where the two sides extended a trade truce reached in Geneva in May 2025 by another year.

Trump agreed to lower tariffs previously used to pressure cooperation on combating the fentanyl crisis. For its part, China committed to purchasing US soybeans and also agreed to postpone by a year its proposed export controls on rare-earth minerals. 

President Donald Trump told reporters earlier this week that he was going to discuss US arms sales to Taiwan with President Xi.

"I’m going to have that discussion with President Xi," Trump said. But the words alarmed allies since that would break with the traditional US policy of maintaining "strategic ambiguity" that is designed to avoid provoking either side.

body.en:
When China's leader Xi Jinping hosts his American counterpart in Beijing this week, Donald Trump will be reminded of his last visit in 2017 – he was wooed hard, complete with dinner inside the Forbidden City, an honour no US president before him had received.

This week's reception promises to be just as grand, including a stop inside Zhongnanhai, the rarefied compound where China's top leadership lives and works. The agenda too will be just as thorny, with Iran being a new source of tension, alongside trade, technology and Taiwan.

But a lot has changed as Trump returns to a stronger and far more assertive China. Now well into an unprecedented third term, an ambitious Xi has been pushing forward with plans for "new productive forces" with heavy investments in renewable energy, robotics and artificial intelligence.

If the American president and his administration want a glimpse of the future Beijing has been reaching for in the last decade, they have to look beyond the imposing heart of the capital where they will spend much of their time.

In the remote, rugged north, solar and wind power now dominates vast landscapes. In the industrious south, automation is reshaping factories and supply chains, and megacities like Chongqing have become the stuff of influencers' feeds.

Billions in state funding have transformed Chongqing, a gritty manufacturing hub deep in the south-west into a powerhouse symbol of a changing China that is embracing new tech, new trade and a new adjective – trendy – as it tries to show the world a friendlier face.

Back in 2017, China was trying to prove it was on an equal footing to the US, says Ali Wyne, senior research and advocacy adviser for US-China relations at International Crisis Group.

"I think that the Chinese delegation understandably expended an enormous amount of diplomatic effort trying to convey the impression that President Xi was President Trump's geopolitical equal. What I find striking is that this time around that assertion isn't necessary on the part of Chinese."

Washington now acknowledges China as a "near-peer", says Wyne, who describes Beijing as "arguably the most powerful competitor that the United States has confronted in its history".

Trump, in turn, may well be the most mercurial foreign leader China has ever encountered. He even has a nickname here - Chuan Jianguo, which means "Trump the nation builder". Online many Chinese believe that his divisive policies and trade wars have helped China's rise by weakening America's global standing.

"He doesn't care about the consequences at all," says a middle-aged man on holiday in Chongqing. "He should know that we share the same world. It is a global village. He should not always put America first."

body.en:
Donald Trump was due to arrive in Beijing on Wednesday, the first visit to China by a US president in nearly a decade, as he seeks to ramp up trade despite potential friction over Taiwan and Iran.

Leaving Washington DC on Wednesday on a trip that was delayed by his war, Trump said he expected a "long talk" with counterpart Xi Jinping about Iran, which relies on China as the top customer for its US-sanctioned oil.

But he also played down disagreements on Iran, saying that Xi has been "relatively good, to be honest with you".

"I don't think we need any help with Iran. We'll win it one way or the other. We'll win it peacefully or otherwise," Trump told reporters as he left the White House.

This week's trip — the first since Trump visited in 2017 — will involve high-stakes talks with Xi on Friday and Saturday, during a packed itinerary that includes a state banquet and tea reception.

Trump said on Tuesday that he would speak to Xi about US arms sales to Taiwan, the self-governing island claimed by China — a departure from historic US insistence that it will not consult China on its support to the island.

China's controls on rare earth exports and the countries' raucous trade relationship are among the topics expected to be taken up by the heads of the world's top two economies.

The tense buildup to the superpower summit was already visible on Wednesday on the streets of Beijing, with police monitoring major intersections and checking the ID cards of passengers on the metro, Agence France-Presse (AFP) journalists saw.

"It's definitely a big deal," said Wen Wen, a 24-year-old woman travelling from the eastern city of Nanjing, when asked by AFP about Trump's visit.

"Some progress will certainly be made," she said, noting that she hopes China and the United States can ensure "lasting peace" despite "recent instability in the global situation".

Trade ties between China and the US have been fraught in recent years. The two sides are currently maintaining a one-year truce in their tariff war reached at Trump and Xi's last meeting in South Korea in October.

China's major surplus in trade with the United States has long irritated Trump, who slapped tariffs on the country's goods during his first term in office.

Trump will be accompanied in China by a large group of top US business executives, including Tesla's Elon Musk and Apple's Tim Cook, the White House has said.

The highly anticipated summit comes at an uncertain time for China's economy, which has struggled in recent years with sluggish domestic spending and a protracted debt crisis in the once-booming property sector.

body.en:
Security around Beijing's historic Tiananmen Square has been heightened for days, with rumours on social media swirling of a special parade or some big, choreographed event.

Preparations for this major event have started with a whisper, but China appears ready to put on a show for US President Donald Trump.

The visit will include talks, a banquet, and a visit to the Temple of Heaven, a complex of imperial temples where emperors would pray for a good harvest.

And both Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping will be hoping the visit will bear fruit. This summit between the world's two most powerful leaders is set to be one of the most consequential encounters for years.

For months, US-China relations have been a lower priority for Trump. His focus has been on the ongoing war with Iran, military operations in the Western Hemisphere and domestic concerns. But that all changes this week. The future of global trade, rising tensions in Taiwan, and competition in advanced technologies are all at stake.

Economically, the ongoing trade war with the US and the conflict in Iran may be bad news for Xi, but ideologically and politically they're a gift and he will feel he has a strong hand.

This visit could set the groundwork for future co-operation – or conflict – in the years ahead.

Speaking to reporters at the White House before heading to China on Tuesday, Trump said he would have a "long talk" about Iran with the Chinese leader.

China is trying to quietly step in as a peacemaker with the war, now in its third month. Beijing has joined Pakistan as a mediator in the US-Israel war against Iran.

Officials in Beijing and Islamabad presented a five-point plan in March with the aim of bringing about a ceasefire and reopening the Strait of Hormuz. And behind the scenes, Chinese officials have been gently nudging their Iranian counterparts towards the negotiation table.

There's no doubt, despite its steady show of strength, that China is eager for an end to this war.

The country's economy is already battling slower growth and higher unemployment. Increasing oil prices have driven up the cost of items made with petrochemicals, everything from textiles to plastics. For some producers in China, costs have gone up 20%.

China has enviable oil reserves and the lead it has taken in renewables and electric cars has insulated it from the worst effects of the fuel crisis, but the war is causing more pain to a sluggish Chinese economy that is heavily reliant on exports. However, if China is to step in and help the US, it will still want something in return.

title.en: Donald Trump is set to land in China for historic talks — and he's bringing an old friend

summary.en: The US president is due in Beijing on Thursday for a two-day summit with Xi Jinping.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自中国栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
United States President Donald Trump is set to visit Beijing on Thursday for a historic meeting between the world leaders, the first on Chinese soil in nearly a decade.

The 14 to 15 May meeting had originally been scheduled for March. However, US-Israeli strikes on Iran, which sparked the war in the Middle East , caused a delay in proceedings.

On the agenda is a normalisation of trade relations following a tariff war Trump announced last year , which saw import taxes rise to as high as 145 per cent. The fate of Taiwan is also likely to be discussed, as is the possible regulation of artificial intelligence.

China claims Taiwan as its own territory, which should be taken by force if necessary. Taiwan says it is an independent country and will defend its freedoms and democracy

The war in the Middle East is, however, likely to dominate. China is reportedly very concerned about the prospect of a global recession as the conflict continues to drag on, impacting energy supplies and trade.

The US is likely to request assistance from China — as the major buyer of Iranian oil — in pressuring the Middle Eastern nation to open the blockaded Strait of Hormuz .

Analysts have suggested that the meeting is unlikely to result in any major breakthroughs, although a pause in tariff escalations could be extended beyond the current October deadline.

Trump "kind of needs China more than China needs him," Alejandro Reyes, a professor specialising in Chinese foreign policy at the University of Hong Kong told the Reuters news agency.

"He needs a kind of foreign policy victory: a victory that shows that he is looking to ensure stability in the world and that he's not just disrupting global politics."

A White House official has confirmed to US broadcaster Bloomberg that Tesla boss Elon Musk and outgoing Apple CEO Tim Cook have been invited to accompany Trump during his visit to Beijing.

The invitation has been extended to other leaders in technology and finance, with representatives from asset manager BlackRock, investment bank Goldman Sachs, semi conductor coporation Qualcomm, Boeing, Meta Platforms, Mastercard, and Visa among the more than a dozen business officials requested.

The executives from some of the US' most powerful business groups could be there to encourage trade normalisation and potentially make deals with Chinese producers.

Exports of rare earth minerals to the US were temporarily halted during the trade war last year, materials that are essential for the output of US technology firms.

Musk, the outspoken billionaire who once headed Trump's so-called Department of Government Efficiency , has yet to confirm whether or not he will be attending.

title.en: Trump's China visit set to test fragile truce

summary.en: The first US presidential visit to China in almost 10 years will test a fragile tariff truce.

body.en:
Beijing has confirmed that US President Donald Trump will travel to China this week to meet Xi Jinping.

The visit, from 13-15 May, will be the first to China by a US president in nearly a decade - and comes at a pivotal moment for ties between the world's two largest economies.

Executives from some of America's biggest companies - including Boeing, Citigroup and Qualcomm - are expected to travel with Trump, potentially to make deals with Chinese firms. It will also mark a key test in the fragile trade truce between Washington and Beijing.

In April 2025, Trump unveiled sweeping import taxes on countries across the world, friend or foe.

A major effect of that policy was a tit-for-tat trade war between the US and China that saw them hit each other with tariffs that topped 100%. The tariffs were paused after Trump and Xi's last face-to-face meeting in South Korea in October. But threats from both sides have continued.

Trump won the 2016 election vowing to make trade fairer for the US and to bring manufacturing jobs back to the country.

In 2018, he announced tariffs on $250bn (£185bn) of Chinese imports - the moment that many analysts say the trade war started .

The same year, Trump imposed levies on other trading partners - including Mexico, Canada and Europe - which he said were also taking advantage of the US.

The sweeping measures were a shock, especially for China, said policy researcher Ning Leng from Georgetown University.

"It was the first time they dealt with Trump seriously, and they probably did not expect him to go ahead with it," Leng said.

The US was a key importer of Chinese manufactured goods, putting its workers at risk if American buyers turned away due to Trump's tariffs.

The tensions added to existing issues that have weighed on China's economy for years, including sluggish domestic consumption, high unemployment and a prolonged property crisis.

Exports to the US offered a lifeline for Chinese jobs, but with Trump, that was now put at risk.

"It's harder for one country to withstand a trade war with another that it has a trade surplus with," Leng said.

His administration chose not to lift Trump's tariffs on China, sharing a belief that the US needed to keep a lid on its rival's growth in sectors like technology, Leng said.

Biden also introduced restrictions on Chinese firms, including tech giant Huawei, which was essentially ousted from the US over national security concerns. He also put TikTok under scrutiny, with its US operation eventually being separated from its Chinese parent company.

Chinese electric vehicles (EVs) were also effectively blocked from the US market after heavy tariffs were imposed by Biden.

title.en: The geopolitical weaponization of shipping channels
title.zh: 航运通道的地缘政治武器化

summary.en: The crisis in the Strait of Hormuz has drawn attention to other vital shipping routes like the Taiwan Strait and the Strait of Malacca. Experts warn that these waterways are increasingly being used by nations to exert geopolitical pressure.

body.en:
The crisis around the Strait of Hormuz has renewed focus on other key shipping routes. Experts warn that waterways like the Taiwan Strait or the Strait of Malacca are increasingly used to exert pressure.

Could imposing a toll to pass through the Strait of Malacca, the narrow stretch of water that connects the Indian Ocean with the Pacific, be a profitable business?

Indonesia's Finance Minister Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa seemed to float the idea at the end of April. "If we split it three ways between Indonesia , Malaysia, and Singapore, that could be quite something, right?" he said.

He later clarified that he was not being entirely serious after Indonesian Foreign Minister Sugiono said that his country supported the freedom of navigation and would not be imposing tolls on vessels passing through the strait, which runs between Indonesia, Malaysia, and Singapore.

Nonetheless, the remark raised the specter of maritime traffic being misused for geopolitical leverage, not just in the Strait of Hormuz , but in other waterways, too. "The closure of the Strait of Hormuz has forced policymakers in Asia to face questions over the security of other maritime chokepoints," wrote the Reuters news agency.

The Strait of Malacca is of particular concern. This is the most important  shipping route between East Asia, the Middle East, and Europe, accounting for around 22% of international maritime trade.

But there are other issues of concern besides piracy and regional conflict. In November last year, the Center for Strategic and International Studies (CSIS) warned of this new danger.

Even non-state actors are now in a position to seriously disrupt the flow of global trade, the think tank said, citing attacks by the Houthi militia in the Red Sea. Many shipping companies now avoid passing through the Suez Canal, taking the longer route around the Cape of Good Hope instead, which significantly impacts supply chains and prices.

Political scientist Nikolaus Scholik, former colonel in the Austrian army and senior advisor at the Austria Institute for European and Security Policy (AIES), believes that these are signs of a fundamental change in the geopolitical balance of power .

"We are experiencing today the consequences of a development in which individual states believe they can legally dominate strategically important maritime straits," he told DW. It would be particularly dangerous, he added, if straits like Hormuz, Malacca, or Taiwan were to become levers of geopolitical influence.
